summary: Frontend-only re-verification of the Carlos Sibaja v2 portfolio at both 1920x1080 and 390x844. All 11 requested feature areas PASS. Explicitly re-verified the previous ORB image regression — no broken images anywhere (13 elements on desktop, 0 broken, 0 unloaded after scroll). The full drone masonry gallery (8 photos) and every case-study gallery image render successfully. All modal close paths (X, scrim, Escape) work and body scroll lock/unlock is correct.
critical_code_review_comments: portfolio.js IMG() helper now correctly preserves the unsplash slug prefix (photo-<slug>?...). The earlier ORB / naturalWidth=0 regression is confirmed fixed — all 13 rendered images (hero centerpiece, 4 project covers, gallery images in the currently-opened modal, and 8 drone photos on desktop) return non-zero naturalWidth.
PROFILE.linkedin is still the LinkedIn root ('https://www.linkedin.com/') — not blocking but Carlos should replace with his actual profile URL.

ProjectModal outer wrapper has 'overflow-hidden' while the inner panel is the real scroll container (overflow-y-auto). This is intentional; verified flagship modal is scrollable (scrollHeight 4524 vs clientHeight 970).

Navbar spec calls links Home/Projects/History/Contact/Drone with testids nav-home / nav-projects / nav-about / nav-contact / nav-drone — matches implementation (History label maps to id 'about'). Confirmed by test.
Contact.jsx uses the LINKS[].icon field for the data-testid (link-linkedin, link-mail, link-file, link-camera) — matches the spec exactly.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All data-testid selectors are stable and match spec. Notes for next runs: (1) Do NOT use wait_for_load_state('networkidle') — background animation traffic keeps the network active; use wait_for_selector('[data-testid=navbar]'). (2) To close modal-scrim, click at a coordinate OUTSIDE the modal panel (e.g. page.mouse.click(10,10)) — the scrim's centered click is behind the panel. (3) Drone photos have loading='lazy'; scroll #drone into view and wait ~4-8s to guarantee load before checking naturalWidth. (4) Hero-featured-chip opens the same modal as project-card-cobot-ultrasonic (flagship). (5) Toast for Resume uses [data-sonner-toaster] container; content is 'Resume coming soon' + 'Carlos will upload the downloadable PDF shortly.'.
